title: Testing with pytest
description: The pytest testing framework in depth: fixtures, parametrization, mocking, coverage, and configuration. Assumes you already know Python (see this library's python-basics course) and general testing vocabulary (see testing-in-software-engineering) — this course is about the pytest tool itself.

changelog.notes: Initial release — 23 decks, each pack with a preview card teaching the concept before its graded main card and practice cards.
The match card on fixture scopes no longer gives the class scope away by repeating the word "class" in its answer.
Glossary: every term now points at one link, so the same word never sends you to two different pages.
Adds Learn more articles (17, each with a worked example) for the glossary terms; tapping a term now offers "Read the full explanation".
Removes the Wikipedia links from glossary terms that have a Learn more article; the article is now the single place to read more.
Rewrites the Learn more articles in a warmer, teacher-to-student voice; no change to the content or the glossary.
